rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a squat, thick, irregular piece of solid material.

example.english: I bought a chunk of wood to make a little stand.
example.traditional: 我買咗一嚿木頭返嚟整架仔。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 gau6 muk6 tau4 faan1 lei4 zing2 gaa3 zai2

rows.note: Use this for a substantial portion of something, especially an abstract or non-monetary amount.

example.english: A large chunk of our time this year went into learning Cantonese.
example.traditional: 我哋今年嘅時間有一大部分用咗嚟學廣東話。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gam1 nin4 ge3 si4 gaan3 jau5 jat1 daai6 bou6 fan6 jung6 zo2 lai4 hok6 gwong2 dung1 waa2

rows.note: Use this for a large sum or substantial financial amount, usually with an understood or stated noun such as 錢.

example.english: They paid a large chunk of money all at once to buy a flat.
example.traditional: 佢哋一次過畀咗一大筆錢買樓。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 jat1 ci3 gwo3 bei2 zo2 jat1 daai6 bat1 cin2 maai5 lau4
